Set up OAuth credentials first Uploading acts on your behalf, which an API key can't do. You need OAuth credentials from Google Cloud Console.
  1. Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project.
  2. Enable the YouTube Data API v3 for it.
  3. Under Credentials, create an OAuth client ID of type Web application.
  4. Add this exact redirect URI: {{ redirect_uri or 'http://localhost:5002/studio/oauth/callback' }}
  5. Download the JSON and save it as client_secret.json next to run.py — or put the ID and secret in .env.
  6. Restart the server and this panel will offer a Connect button.
